title: Zirox SNMP
description: Devices polled by Zirox SNMP Exporter: group overview, device details, ports and health.

panels.title: Not responding
panels.description: Devices whose last SNMP poll failed.

panels.title: Ports down
panels.description: Ports that are administratively up but operationally down.

targets.expr: count(ifOperStatus{group=~"$group"} == 2 and on(device, ifIndex) ifAdminStatus == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Hardware problems
panels.description: CISCO-ENVMON sensors, fans or PSUs not in normal state.

panels.title: Total traffic in
panels.description: Sum of inbound traffic over all polled ports in the selected groups.

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: All devices in the selected groups. Click a device name to open its details below.

panels.title: Top 10 ports by traffic
panels.description: Busiest ports in the selected groups, by the larger of in and out.

panels.title: Top 10 ports by utilization
panels.description: Load in % of port speed, by the larger of in and out.

panels.title: Ports down (admin up)
panels.description: Ports that should be up but are not.

targets.expr: count(ifOperStatus{device="$device"} == 2 and on(ifIndex) ifAdminStatus{device="$device"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Traffic (in up, out down)
panels.description: Inbound traffic above zero, outbound below. Ports with no traffic (under 10 kbit/s) are hidden. Click a name in the legend to show only that port; sort by Max to find the busiest.

panels.title: Utilization
panels.description: Load in % of port speed. Orange above 70 %, red above 90 %. Idle ports are hidden.

panels.title: Errors and discards
panels.description: Packets per minute. Only ports that have errors or discards are shown. Empty is good.

panels.title: Ports
panels.description: Every polled port of the device. Click a column header to sort, the funnel icon to filter.

targets.expr: 100 * (rate(ifHCInOctets{device="$device", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m]) > rate(ifHCOutOctets{device="$device", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m]) or rate(ifHCOutOctets{device="$device", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m])) * 8 / (ifHighSpeed{device="$device", ifName=~"$interface"} * 1e6 > 0)
count(zirox_bgp_peer_state{device="$device"} != 6 and on(device, peer) zirox_bgp_peer_admin_status == 2) or vector(0)
